niche.habitat: Dense, multi-species galactic union zones; variable-gravity worlds with complex atmospheric layers and nutrient-rich atmospheric particulates.
niche.diet: Omnivorous filter-feeder and symbiotic nutrient-gatherer; consumes processed biological slurry, ambient chemical gradients, and cultivated microbial blooms.
niche.active: Continuous; shifts activity cycles to match host-star flares, union trade rhythms, and atmospheric density shifts.

body: Dual cranial sensory arrays with fused ganglia <- why? 360° threat detection without turning <- why? Evolved in high-biodensity union habitats where rapid negotiation and ambush avoidance are critical <- why? Complex ecological niches favor omnidirectional awareness -> SKILL: 'Dual Focus' (Engage): perceive two directions simultaneously, read micro-expressions in both heads, with a weakness to sensory overload in chaotic environments. Retractile pharyngeal manipulators <- why? Specialize mouthparts for delicate interaction without compromising feeding <- why? High-resource environments reward division of labor between intake and manipulation <- why? Dense atmospheric pressure allows precise pharyngeal thrust and tool use -> SKILL: 'Pharyngeal Weave' (Control): deploy hidden manipulators for crafting, bonding, or combat, with a weakness to vulnerability during extension.

chains.trait: Dual cranial sensory arrays with fused ganglia
links: Distributed command avoids kinematic lag across multi-meter spines
microgravity removes hydrostatic counterweights that stabilize alignment
mass distribution anomalies and tidal forces persist
lack of gravitational loading allows neural hypertrophy (speculative)

skill.effect: Coordinates ally actions and reduces discord in multi-faction encounters by 2.

chains.weakness: Vulnerable to neural latency if both heads are targeted simultaneously.
observe: Symmetrical cranial ridges aligned on opposite body ends
Twin optic slits that dilate independently
Massive cranial bulges relative to body girth

journal.en: They think in chorus; one voice is never enough for a galaxy union.

plausibility.summary: Keep both heads but make one chiefly sensory/communicative and the other chiefly motor/orienting, linked by a high-bandwidth fusion tract (not two independent brains); in arks, add lateral-line–style proprioception along the body wall to replace lost hydrostatic ‘which way is down’ cues.

primary head maintains propulsion and atmospheric sampling

Smooth, seamless cranial armor on the contact end

journal.en: A diplomat’s tongue is a tool; keep the brain out of the negotiation room.

relations.note: Both stretch limbs and reinforce joints to dance through microgravity. Spacers jet; Amphicephali grip. Convergent elegance. -> Skill: 'Micro-g precision' (Engage)

Author's chemical archival nodes and photoreceptive dermal patches mimic the dual-sensory complexity of Amphicephali fused ganglia to decode union records without the social neural architecture. -> Skill: 'Sensory decryption' (Basic)

Amphicephali's fused ganglia and pharyngeal manipulators actively harvest historical data from Author's archival nodes, treating them as living libraries to be consumed and integrated into their union. -> Skill: 'Archive siphon' (Poke)

temperament: They negotiate first, strike second, and view biological diversity as a living ledger rather than a resource to be exhausted.
secrets: Their fused ganglia can temporarily sync with another species' neural rhythm, enabling instant trust or forced compliance.
The retractile body is not just a tool but a dormant reproductive pod; extending it fully signals mating readiness to compatible unions.
moments: When two heads lock in a slow, synchronized blink, they are calibrating their fused ganglia to harmonize with a partner's biofield.
A sudden retraction of the pharyngeal manipulators into the cranial base signals a breakdown in negotiations, triggering a defensive posture.
